description:
Situated in the heart of the Costa del Sol, these stunning Mijas Costa apartments for sale with sea views form part of a boutique complex featuring 22 exquisite 2 and 3-bedroom homes in a prime location, providing residents with the tranquil atmosphere of coastal living while enjoying the luxurious amenities of an exclusive community.

Step into your new home and start enjoying the exceptional qualities and attention to detail that define these homes. Every aspect of the design of these apartments for sale has been carefully considered, from the layout of the open spaces to the selection of premium materials and finishes, ensuring a living environment that is as luxurious as it is inviting.

The open-concept layout creates a seamless flow between the living room, dining room, kitchen, and terrace, providing the perfect setting for entertaining guests or simply enjoying quality time with your loved ones. Whether you are hosting a dinner party or enjoying a quiet evening in, you will appreciate the versatility and functionality of these thoughtfully designed spaces.

Large picture windows are one of the standout features of these apartments, adding both aesthetic appeal and practical benefits to the living spaces. These expansive windows serve as portals to the breathtaking coastal views, inviting the beauty of the outdoors to seamlessly merge with the indoors.

Enjoy a dip in the pool with stunning Mediterranean views and unwind in the serene communal areas. Wake up to a fully equipped gym for convenient workouts at home, or indulge in relaxation at the spa for a peaceful escape after a busy day. Experience the lush garden,

designed with sustainability in mind, creating visual oases throughout the complex.

The enclosed urbanization sits on the eastern edge of Mijas Costa, next to Fuengirola. This prime location offers stunning Mediterranean views and convenient access to beaches, entertainment, and services. Mijas Costa stretches for 12 kilometres along the beaches of Calahonda and La Cala de Mijas, and it offers easy access to Malaga city, the airport and Marbella.

You will find a selection of world-class golf courses, leisure activities, entertainment, shopping and dining options nearby. These apartments for sale in Mijas Costa guarantee an outstanding quality of life, combining superb weather, cultural diversity, and desirable lifestyle amenities. Book your viewing today and secure your dream apartment in this exceptional location.
